json.description: Any JSON value, carried verbatim. Strings inside it are never references to other parts of the document.

attrs.description: The attributes the style sets, by VectorCraft's command parameter names (for example `size`, `fontFamily`, `leading`, `fill`, `justify`, `spaceBefore`, `tabs`), each with the value the style gives it; an attribute that is not listed is left as it is. The attributes a run or paragraph actually has are always spelled out on the run or paragraph itself, so a reader that only draws need not resolve styles. Absent: no attributes.

name.description: The style's name: what `style_name` of a run or paragraph names it by.

character.description: Character styles, in panel order. Absent: none.

paragraph.description: Paragraph styles, in panel order. Absent: none.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

title: core.text.styles - the character and paragraph styles of a vector-art/1 document
